trap.label: should britânico
trap.wrong: I suggest that he should to be on time.
trap.right: I suggest that he be on time.
trap.why: O brasileiro acrescenta should e to por influência de “que ele deva estar”. A forma americana usa só a base: that he be.

mcq.q: I suggest that he ___ on time. (American)
Britânico: I suggest that he ___ be on time.
She demanded that he ___ the door.
It is vital that she ___ present.

fix.wrong: I suggest that he is on time.
fix.right: I suggest that he be on time.

fix.wrong: She demanded that he opens the door.
fix.right: She demanded that he open the door.

fix.wrong: I propose that he should to leave.

rewrite.prompt: Americano: “I suggest that he should be on time.”
rewrite.answer: I suggest that he be on time.

rewrite.prompt: Subj.: “She demanded that he opened the door.”
rewrite.answer: She demanded that he open the door.

rewrite.prompt: Subj.: “I insist that she is present.”
rewrite.answer: I insist that she be present.
